Name: Solar Machine Framework
Author: klatuprism
Description:
To keep Stardew Valley in its pristine natural beauty a new line of Solar Powered machines is being introduced.  This mod is a framework that allows any machine to be converted to a solar powered machine.  Instead of needing coal for fuel, the machines require at least 1 solar panel be placed beside it.  A total of 8 panels can be put around a machine.  This provides more charge power and gives faster charging times to the machine.  The machines will charge up at a rate determined by the number of panels, the season, the weather and the time of day.  If a machine runs out of power, while charging, its production is put on hold until the battery can be re-charged to resume processing.  When a solar panel is charging a machine, it will no longer produce batteries.  Once the machine is fully charged, the solar panel will resume battery production.  The machines are fully compatible with Automate.

Included in the download:

[list]
[*]The Solar Machine Framework (SMF)
[*]A converted Furnace (eFurnace)
[*]A converted Smoker (eSmoker)
[/list]
The furnace and smoker have the same recipes as the base models, just the need for coal has been replaced by the need for solar panels.  The machines can be purchased at Clint's shop and as the Farmer progresses, the recipes to make the machines will be passed onto the Farmer.



[size=5][b][u]For Modders[/u][/b][/size]

It is very simple to create a solar powered machine.  Follow the normal steps to create a custom machine, make the images and create the Content Patcher files.  The only additional step is to create a Solar Machine Framework (SMF) content patcher entry.  More details on creating an eMachine can be found in this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3894]article[/url].


Source code: [url=https://github.com/Prism-99/Solar-Machine-Framework]GitHub[/url]
